honestReading: Latency gates PASS on both paths at 100 users: gateway p50 89.79ms / p99 340.49ms vs direct p50 85.79ms / p99 356.67ms — the gateway adds no meaningful per-request overhead.

The gateway run reports a 98.96% 'error' rate because all non-first requests were HTTP 429: the RedisIpRateLimiter (60 req / 10s / IP, ZSET+Lua shared window) correctly capped a single source IP hammering the endpoint. This is the rate limiter WORKING, not an availability failure — direct game-service under identical load had 0 errors.

scripts/load-test.mjs counts 429 in its errorRate (documented harness quirk, ADR-locked thresholds); do not read that number as a crash rate. No 4xx/5xx other than 429 and no service DOWN were observed.

A separate run at 200-250 users saw p99 1.2-1.7s; host had another project's specproof-rabbitmq at ~103% CPU during the run. Our ten containers were each <1% CPU. Treat that tail as host contention, not a code regression.
Full stack was up healthy (discovery/config/gateway/game/ai/season/presence/notification/redis/postgres) before the run.
environmentNote: Local self-hosted Docker Desktop, host shared with other active projects' containers; numbers are MEASURED on this machine, not production capacity claims.
reproduce: cd server && docker compose up -d discovery config redis postgres game-service season-service presence-service notification-service ai-service gateway && node ../scripts/load-test.mjs --scenario=version --users=100 --duration-ms=6000 --target=http://localhost:19880 --json
